Joins tract code violation counts for 2026 with CDC high blood pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 residents, and returns the cross-tract correlation and paired tract count ordered by the violation rate.
sql:
WITH code_violations AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS code_violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_df4bd6'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
cdc AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_df4bd6_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid,
    t.name,
    COALESCE(cv.code_violations_count, 0) AS code_violations_count,
    c.totalpopulation,
    c.totalpop18plus,
    c.high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
    (COALESCE(cv.code_violations_count, 0) / c.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS code_violations_per_1000_residents
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN code_violations cv ON t.geoid = cv.geoid
  JOIN cdc c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  WHERE c.high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  name,
  code_violations_per_1000_residents,
  code_violations_count,
  totalpopulation,
  high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  totalpop18plus,
  CORR(code_violations_per_1000_residents, high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS code_violations_vs_high_blood_pressure_corr,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
